name: Mama G’s Kitchen & Sauces Peruvian Cuisine
notes: 3 photos: photo1 is an older single-page printed menu at lower prices; photos 2-3 are a newer laminated menu book with a full price increase, a new Soups section, and reworked items — treated as canonical/current, photo1 excluded as superseded pricing (its only unmatched item, Classic Cheeseburger, was dropped along with it). Soup and salad cup/bowl and small/large sizes, and Choros a la Chalaca's 6pc/12pc sizes, were split into separate entries; Pollo a la Brasa's Combo upcharge (adds 2 sides) was treated as a modifier and only Solo pricing was kept.
